Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000718": The notifier is not Cinder's service, so Cinder flagged the issue instead of fixing it.  (about: Cinder, notifier)
- memory_id "1000714": The notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-09-26.  (about: Cinder, notifier, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000676": Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy.  (about: flags service, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000652" [decision]: The webhooks service belongs to Team Atlas as of 2025-09-09, after Ember handed it over.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service, Ember)
- memory_id "1000644": Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service, Ember)
- memory_id "1000610": The indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-29.  (about: Cinder, indexer, retention change)
- memory_id "1000595": The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20.  (about: Cinder, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000581": After the cache change, the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000473" [decision]: The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it.  (about: Boreal, Team Dune, Ember, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000418": The reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change.  (about: reports pipeline, retention change)
- memory_id "1000396": Oskar is on call for team Ember this cycle.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000344": Ember runs its planning meeting on Fridays.  (about: Ember)
- memory_id "1000273": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000271" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000234" [decision]: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember)
- memory_id "1000232": After the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000223" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds as follow-up to INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000220": INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000216": Notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000095" [decision]: The first on-call rotation for team Ember goes to Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000084": Oskar is the only engineer on team Ember as of 2025-01-10.  (about: Oskar, Ember)
- memory_id "1000061": Boreal owns notifier.  (about: Boreal, notifier)
Existing entity names: Cinder, notifier, client rollout, flags service, Team Dune, Team Atlas, webhooks service, Ember, indexer, retention change, reporting service, product catalog, Boreal, reports pipeline, Oskar, push provider, INC-2025-004

The note:

[2025-11-05] standup/ember/2025-11-05: Heads-up from Ember: notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.
